why: The ahead clock run's one machine (e2e.yml with clock: ahead, WORKLIST P2.4): every flow in .maestro/clock/ahead, the phone's clock set ahead and put back before the next. Read by e2e/shards.mjs and run-flows.sh; clockJudges.test.ts holds it to the folder and to clock-judges.mjs's list. Each flow signs in, opens every tab and logs a film: about five minutes on the runner.
probesElsewhere: The keyboard probes and the launch with animations run in the normal rounds (e2e/shards.json); a clock run tests the phone's clock, not them.
